newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW sees 97 volume growth of 8-10 pct.
newsitem.headline: VW sees 97 volume growth of 8-10 pct.

text.p: German car giant Volkswagen AG said on Tuesday it planned volume growth between eight and 10 percent for 1997 after an 11 percent rise in customer deliveries in the first four months of the year.
Deliveries to customers rose 11.2 percent to 1.43 million units in the first four months of the current year, the car-maker said at at a presentation of its Passat "Variant" model in Hamburg.
VW chief executive Ferdinand Piech further confirmed the planned volume growth for the year at the presentation.
